_comment: ComiCal SWA configuration. SWA ignores unknown top-level / nested `_comment` keys; we use them as inline JSON documentation. See docs/specs/oo-init/11-auth-session.md and 15-security.md.

navigationFallback._comment: SSR / SPA fallback: serve index.html for client-routed paths but never intercept API, auth, or static asset requests.

routes._comment: API is callable by both anonymous (Phase 1 browse/search) and authenticated users; per-endpoint authz is enforced server-side via SwaAuthMiddleware + RequiresAuthenticatedUserAttribute.
Long-lived cache for hashed JS/CSS/font/image bundles emitted by Angular `outputHashing: all`. Filenames embed a content hash so `immutable` is safe.
Authenticated-only zones (Phase 2+): account dashboard, /me/* APIs, settings.

responseOverrides._comment: Unauthenticated / forbidden requests on guarded routes redirect to /login so the SWA Auth flow can kick in. SWA emits 302 + Location header.

globalHeaders.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' https://*.blob.core.windows.net data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://*.applicationinsights.azure.com https://*.in.applicationinsights.azure.com; font-src 'self' data:; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self' https://*.b2clogin.com https://*.ciamlogin.com

auth._comment: Custom OIDC integration with Entra External ID (formerly Azure AD B2C). All registration values are *setting names* — actual values come from App Settings injected via Key Vault references (see infra/modules/app.bicep).
